source.title: Table 6. Means of Financing — Liability Accounts

unit_note: USD millions. Page 23 Table 6 Liability Accounts. Column 5 carries the printed header Beginning of This Month (Account Balance); in October (Month 1 of FY2027), Beginning of This Year (col 4) and Beginning of This Month (col 5) both hold the FY2026 closing balances, and both DESIGN 4a roll-forward classes (c5 + c1 = c6 and c4 + c2 = c6) are declared across all 17 rows alongside the 30 vertical section sums (64 relations total). Opening balances match September #558 close except Uninvested Balances, Deposit Funds (33,437 vs September's 33,436, +$1M agency restatement).

cells.why: Column 3 (Fiscal Year to Date Prior Year) has no opening/closing balance roll-forward in Table 6, and Total Treasury Securities Net of Premium and Discount (row 6 = row 3 + row 4 - row 5) combines positive Plus Premium and subtracted positive Less Discount, which is not a pure additive sum relation.

Column 3 (Fiscal Year to Date Prior Year) has no opening/closing balance roll-forward in Table 6, and Total Treasury Securities Net of Premium and Discount (row 6 = row 3 + row 4 - row 5) combines positive Plus Premium and subtracted positive Less Discount, which is not a pure additive sum relation.
